triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.visits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_links_cleanup AFTER DELETE ON public.visits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION delete_document_links_for_parent('visit')
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_set_clinic_id_visits BEFORE INSERT ON public.visits FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.clinic_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION set_clinic_id_from_user()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_update_patient_last_visit AFTER INSERT ON public.visits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_patient_last_visit()
CREATE TRIGGER visits_prefill_visit_type BEFORE INSERT ON public.visits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prefill_visit_type_from_appointment()

index.indexdef: CREATE INDEX visits_clinic_type_date_idx ON public.visits USING btree (clinic_id, visit_type, date)
